qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Exclusive state-granted franchise territory and CPUC rate-base regulation grant Southern California Edison a statutory monopoly over regional power transmission and distribution.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 4 (CAP = 10, REJECT). Traditional regulated electric utility is anchored to Tier 4 baseline persistence (CAP 5-10Y). California inverse condemnation doctrine and escalating catastrophic wildfire liabilities (e.g., 2025 Eaton Fire losses, AB 1054 fund depletion risk) combined with massive grid-hardening capex requirements prevent secular compounding.
qualitative.evidence: 10-year median GAAP ROIC of 5.6% reflects capped regulatory returns on invested capital. Realized earnings remain severely volatile due to multi-billion-dollar wildfire liabilities (2017-2018 Thomas/Woolsey fires and 2025 Eaton Fire). Long-term debt exceeds $36B against $17.6B equity, requiring continuous debt issuance to fund $6.5B+ annual capex.
